extraction: Exact R249 primary; circular sigma30 support5sigma, low2/(2pi sigma), no upper cut; eight qualified candidates and brightest-four shortlist; fast source FFT path parity tested.
density: Nested 200/500/1000/2000 on a 2000-point equal-arc master grid. Start200; increase based on speed and association stability. Do not retune extraction.
ambiguity: All eligible links retained; mutual nearest plus margin required. Tentative gaps never merge identities or supply interpolated measurements.
broadness: Largest local quadratic log-power amplitude width >2 Gaussian resolution widths, or nonconcave quadratic. Diagnostic only.
appearance: Gaussian-weighted red/yellow/dark/neutral-highlight HSV proxies are descriptive, include paper, and never select or track peaks.
